thread:
Jenna: Heads-up — SparrowHealth renewal inbound. They want to switch from annual prepay to monthly billing with a 6-month minimum commit and a blanket PO. Procurement also asked about paying in GBP (they're UK entity). Need legal signoff on payment terms and whether RevOps will accept minimum commit instead of term-based discount.
Raj: AE here. Original quote was 12mo prepay at 15% discount. Customer says cashflow hit, asking to keep per-seat price but move to monthly billing with a 6mo minimum and cap on price increases for the year. They can provide a blanket PO.
Olivia: Finance: monthly invoices OK but we need payment terms (Net30) and guarantee for minimums. For GBP payments we need FX handling and to know which billing entity. Also vendor code and VAT ID.
Marco: Legal: monthly + minimum is acceptable but contract needs a Minimum Commitment clause and early-termination fee to cover lost discount. We should not promise cap on price increases beyond a 1yr fixed-price period. Also need signer authority on the PO.
Priya: RevOps: discount tiers are defined by committed months. 6mo minimum would normally fall into the 6-11 mo tier (8% discount). To keep 15% we'd need an exception. Can route for approval but need justification (strategic account / expansion likelihood).
Jenna: Customer says likely to add seats in Q3; they pushed for price parity because it's easier for budget. Will try to get written note on expected add-ons.
Raj: I'll ask the customer to add a short note in the PO about expected seat increase. Also will confirm billing entity (UK Ltd) and VAT number.
Olivia: If UK Ltd pays, invoice should be GBP with VAT handling. We can invoice GBP but Treasury needs to know expected monthly volume for FX buffer.
Marco: Draft clause suggestion below — feel free to copy into amendment:
```
Minimum Commitment: Customer commits to pay for a minimum of 6 months of Services at the agreed per-seat rate. Early termination by Customer during the minimum commitment will result in immediate payment of the remaining net amount due for the minimum period, less payments already made. Pricing Protection: Redwood will not increase per-seat rates for a period of 12 months following amendment effective date.
```
Priya: Also note: to accept blanket PO as billing document we need PO number and authorized sig page or email from procurement. DocuSign envelope ok for contract signature.
DocuSignBot: Envelope draft ready: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ987 (status: draft).
Jenna: Sounds good. Action items: Raj -> get PO + VAT + a short addendum from the customer about expansion (ETA today). Priya -> start RevOps exception request if customer insists on 15% with 6mo minimum (ETA 6h). Marco -> prep minimal amendment language and redline to insert into DocuSign (ETA EOD). Olivia -> confirm GBP invoicing feasibility and vendor code (ETA EOD). I'll update once PO lands. :thumbsup: 
Raj: Pinged customer procurement, they replied that PO will arrive by COB and included VAT ID. Sharing once I have it.
Priya: I'm drafting the exception request. Need expected ARR delta to justify. Jenna can you paste the projected add-on note when you have it?
Jenna: Will paste add-on note here when I get it from Raj.
Olivia: Vendor code 8812 available for UK transactions. Finance requests monthly projection for FX pre-funding.
Marco: Uploaded amendment draft to the envelope and flagged clause for price protection at 12 months.
DocuSignBot: Envelope updated: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ987 (status: updated) :white_check_mark:
Raj: PO just arrived (PO# SH-2026-77), includes VAT ID and statement: "anticipated +20 seats in Q3". Uploading to procurement share.
Jenna: Copying the PO text here: "SparrowHealth UK Ltd will increase up to 20 additional seats in Q3 pending clinical rollout; procurement expects to confirm by Aug 1."
Priya: That helps. I've attached the note to the RevOps exception packet. Submitting now.
Olivia: Noted. Finance will prepare monthly invoice template in GBP with VAT reverse-charge note and Net30 terms.
Marco: Legal approves amendment with the Minimum Commitment clause and payment guarantee. I'll add signer authority check and send final redline to DocuSign.
Jenna: Great — if RevOps approves 15% for 6mo min we can sign this week. Thanks all.
